faqs.q: Is there a free Zapier alternative?
faqs.a: Yes. Make has a free plan with 1,000 credits a month, Activepieces is free for up to 5 users, and 50agents is free to start.

faqs.q: Which Zapier alternative connects the most apps?
faqs.a: Make lists 3,500+ apps and n8n lists 2,829 integrations. 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket. Zapier itself connects 10,541+.

faqs.q: Can I import my Zaps into another tool?
faqs.a: Not directly. Plan to rebuild each Zap in the new tool, starting with the one that runs most often.

faqs.q: Where can I compare these tools more closely?
faqs.a: For a three-way read, see [Zapier vs Make vs n8n for a small team](/guides/zapier-vs-make-vs-n8n-for-a-small-team). For single tools, see [50agents vs Make](/compare/50agents-vs-make), [Activepieces alternatives](/compare/activepieces-alternatives) and [Power Automate alternatives](/compare/power-automate-alternatives).
Free has 100 tasks a month and two-step Zaps only. Professional is $19.99 a month billed yearly for 750 tasks a month.
Zapier counts every action step as a task, so a five-step Zap uses up to five tasks a run. n8n counts one execution per run, however many steps.
Make has AI Agents and n8n has an AI Agent node on all plans. 50agents builds AI agents from plain words.
Make has JavaScript or Python steps, and so does n8n. 50agents has no code step.

faqs.q: Which Zapier alternative is open source?
faqs.a: Activepieces: its core is MIT-licensed and it runs on your own servers. n8n is fair-code under its Sustainable Use License, so you can self-host it, but it is not open source. Pick either to keep the code in-house.

faqs.q: Should I choose n8n or Zapier?
faqs.a: n8n suits technical teams that self-host or want to pay per run: one execution covers every step. Zapier connects 10,541+ apps and counts each action step as a task. See [Zapier vs Make vs n8n for a small team](/guides/zapier-vs-make-vs-n8n-for-a-small-team).

faqs.q: Does Make cost less than Zapier?
faqs.a: At the first paid plan, yes. Make Core is $9 a month for 10,000 credits; Zapier Professional is $19.99 a month billed yearly for 750 tasks. Most Make actions use one credit and every Zapier action step is a task.
